pages.text: Nearly everything here can be changed: Mods, Seafarers, Config, or the file $(l)config/seafarers-common.toml$(). Each setting says what it does.$(br2)Crew sizes, sinking, replacement ships, locks, swaps, the wait between ships, a server ship limit, damage, fire, the wind and more.

$(l)/crew admin ships$() lists every ship; $(l)tp$(), $(l)remove$(), $(l)lock$(), $(l)unlock$() and $(l)captain$() act on one. Permissions mods can grant $(l)seafarers.admin$(), $(l)seafarers.bypass.locks$() and $(l)seafarers.bypass.limits$().
